title: The upload-preview src guard returned a crafted blob: id verbatim and CodeQL could not see it as a sanitizer, so every avatar and attachment preview was a high js/xss-through-dom alert

source.ref: CodeQL js/xss-through-dom (high) at lib/onboarding/step-registry.tsx:109, predating 2026-09-29 (blame bd0f94756, 2026-09-27); owner ruling 2026-09-29 "Investigate and fix"

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-09-29 on the owner ruling "Investigate and fix". CLOSED AS ALREADY TRUE ON MAIN: #3047 (HYG-142, ADR-1637, ce60bbaf5) made the consequence true before this PR could merge, so this row ships only its probe and preview-sink tests. Slated on W2 (foundation) and off it on close. MEASURED at filing, on main d332f1335 with CodeQL 2.27.1 (the codeql-action v4 bundle): XssThroughDom.ql flagged four upload-preview sinks, lib/onboarding/step-registry.tsx:109, app/onboarding/form.tsx:198, components/feed/composer.tsx:561 and components/support/report-dialog.tsx:254. The path is input.files, then URL.createObjectURL (a taint step the query adds), then React state, then . WHAT WAS AND WAS NOT A HOLE. No script could run: an never runs javascript:, SVG through is script-disabled, React escapes the attribute, and the reachable values are a browser-minted blob:/ or the upload URL (lib/storage/profile-images.ts: public URL plus ?t=). But the helper ended in a parse and a prefix test, and the URL parser does not escape a blob: path, so safeUploadPreviewSrc('blob:https://app.local/">') came back verbatim, as did https URLs with credentials. CodeQL models no scheme check as a barrier; the one it applies to every taint configuration is a regexp test anchored at both ends with no wildcard term. WHAT CLOSED IT. #3047 rewrote safeImageSrc so every non-null return is `if (RE.test(safe)) return safe` over five anchored, wildcard-free patterns (path, raster data:, encoded SVG data:, http(s), blob uuid), and safeUploadPreviewSrc starts from that value, so every upload-preview sink now passes an allowlist CodeQL reads. This branch had built the same shape inside safeUploadPreviewSrc (four alerts to zero on the files above, measured with CodeQL 2.27.1); on the fold it took main's helper whole rather than keep a second one. What stays from this row: lib/safe-image-src.test.ts gains two preview-sink cases (ten hostile values, and no returned value can open or close an attribute), and the probe below. No ADR of its own; the decision is ADR-1637.

verify.note: Imports lib/safe-image-src.ts under type stripping: a real blob: preview and a Supabase upload URL pass unchanged, and eight hostile values (a blob id carrying ">, one with an apostrophe, one with a space and <, javascript:, data:text/html, vbscript:, //host, user:pw@host) return null at safeUploadPreviewSrc. Then reads the source: every non-null return in safeImageSrc sits inside `if (RE.test(safe)) return safe`, each RE a literal anchored at both ends with no bare dot, negated class or \S/\W/\D (the one sanitizer shape CodeQL js/xss-through-dom models); safeUploadPreviewSrc starts from safeImageSrc and returns only that value or null; and the step-registry avatar still paints through it. Fails at d332f1335, where this row was filed, on the first hostile value; passes on main since #3047. Mutation-fired: dropping the SAFE_BLOB end anchor, returning the raw input from safeUploadPreviewSrc, and hiding a guard behind exec() each fail it.
